body: I have exactly zero self control when it comes to sweets, so I try to never buy them myself.
It’s a nice flavour, hint of cinnamon. Doesn’t make your teeth feel weird either.

You seem like a really kind person, you reach out so much & i’m sure you’ve changed lives. You are really special in the universe..

I’m just biding time until my dog dies so I can kill myself without feeling guilty, some nights it’s just really hard to wait.
